name: Sycamore Ridge Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from course_data/library/sycamore_ridge/card_review.json, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. review.why: the page's hole numbers are off: its nines are swapped against the card

14: OSM tags hole 14 as par 3, but the tee is 399 yds from the green in the package (404 along the OSM hole line; the page shows 364). It is a par 4.
